minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  June 25, 2024

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting on Tuesday,
  June 25, 2024, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the City
  Council into session at the hour of 3:00 p.m.
  The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Council Members Gray, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and
  Mayor Butts; and
  Absent:  None.
  City officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk
  Mark Weinberg  City Manager
  Derald Brenneman  Acting City Attorney
  Louis Atwell  Assistant City Manager
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

  PUBLIC COMMENTS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present who
  wished to address the City Council on any item on the Agenda.

  There was no response.

101  AGREEMENT NO. 24-271 APPROVED – MURPHY’S BOWL, LLC; MAYOR
  AUTHORIZED – EXECUTION OF AGREEMENT. Staff report dated June 25, 2024,
  was presented recommending that the Mayor and Council Members approve an agreement
  with Murphy’s Bowl, LLC for use of the Intuit Dome.

  It was moved by Council Member Faulk, and seconded by Council Member Morales that
  the City Council does hereby: 1) Approve Agreement No. 24-271; and 2) Authorize the
  Mayor to Execute Agreement. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Gray, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

178  AGREEMENT NO. 24-272 APPROVED – COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES. Staff report
  dated June 25, 2024, was presented recommending that the Mayor and Council Members
  approve an agreement with the County of Los Angeles, authorizing the Chief of Police (or
  designee) to request supplemental law enforcement services for professional sporting and
  entertainment events from the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department (LASD).

  It was moved by Council Member Faulk, and seconded by Council Member Morales that
  the City Council does hereby approve Agreement No. 24-272 not exceeding $9,435,000.
  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Gray, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned at the hour of 3:01 p.m.

  Approved this 10th day of September, 2024.
  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk

  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Mayor
